value: The 61-row arity census of claim.T12_arity-census-the-unread-trailing-parameter-class-sized-for-the-first-time.20260903.v1 has been worked to a disposition, and the class is far smaller than its row count. TWO GENUINE DEFECTS, both caller-side, both in the KNR direction the T12 census ranked LAST. (1) DoTexMods: game/ui/screensaver.c called it with no argument under a `void DoTexMods(void);` prototype while game/anim/atree.c:256 defines `void DoTexMods(atreeseq* seq)` and the target loads `lwz r3,@sPowerupsBuf` immediately before the `bl`; passing sPowerupsBuf took ScreenSaver real 52 -> 48 at held count parity T116/O116 (commit f1834059c). (2) NOT AN ARITY ROW AT ALL but found by reading the same aligned view: screensaver.c:795 masked bit 0 of the s64 gControllerButtons where the target ANDs the FIRST word with 1, i.e. bit 32; correcting it to 0x100000000LL took real 48 -> 38 and removed the function's only two IMMEDIATE divergences (commit 1b98e9997). The three sibling `& 8` sites in the same TU were checked against the target and are ALREADY CORRECT (the target ANDs the second word with 8), so this is a single wrong constant, not a family - an over-generalisation that one aligned view refuted. PHANTOM-CANDIDATE, 4 rows, ALL FOUR REFUTED AS MATCH OPPORTUNITIES: MBNewTempQuad, mbBlitSetPage and screen_limitation each had NO consumer paying for the phantom parameter, because every call site already passes the short list under a (void) or K&R declaration - ScrollMessageBox is byte-EXACT calling MBNewTempQuad() with zero arguments and MBDrawPsysObjects (in the Matching TU game/mb/mb_objects) is byte-EXACT calling mbBlitSetPage() with zero. The parameters were dropped anyway as score-invisible source hygiene, GATE OK byte-identical on both TUs (commit 7e2052c72). fn_800C1174 is UNDECIDABLE FROM BYTES and was deliberately left alone: game/ps2/ml_error.c is a Matching TU whose FatalError passes two arguments for free (r3 and r4 already hold text and errorCode on entry) and whose FatalErrorf passes one with r4 holding a leftover `addi r4,r1,108` from the preceding strcat - both arities reproduce the retail bytes exactly, so the K&R declaration at ml_error.c:69 is faithful as written. THE STRUCTURAL FINDING: a PHANTOM-CANDIDATE row pays only where a SHORT call and a FULL-ARITY call coexist. Three of the four rows have short calls only, so the verdict that the census ranked FIRST for confidence is the one with no payoff mechanism, and 'a trailing parameter the body never reads AND a call site passing fewer arguments' is not by itself a cost. KNR-SHORT-CALL, 15 rows: 1 defect (DoTexMods), 1 already settled negative by its own law (sndFxInit), 1 SDK (CompleteTransfer), 9 refuted by direct target evidence at the call - AudioKillMask, mbBlitProject, HintMenu, LockMem, MBOX_LockModels, NextAttractWave, WorldObjCollide, format_brain, pbSetTexture - 2 undecidable at zero cost (RandInt, mbBlitStub343C), 1 deferred to a claimed TU (DrawTextKeepScale, game/ui/btext held by worker NX). WorldObjCollide deserves its own line: dynobjgrid.c passes four arguments to a five-parameter definition whose fifth (`mtx`) is read NINE times, which reads as the loudest possible defect, and the target simply does not set r6 at the `bl` (the `addi r6,r3,0` nearby is a copy web feeding a store at 0x174). UNREAD-TRAILING, 42 rows: 23 SDK/MSL/TRK/Runtime rows refuted as a CLASS in zero builds (SDK Code is 100.00% matched, 922/922, and no SDK TU appears in webfrank.json, so every consumer is a raw exact passing the full list); 12 game rows refuted by an exact or count-parity-held consumer (dcsVoiceSetMaster settled by AdsSetVolumeDirect, dcsAllocReset, dcsSampleAllocUpload, G3DSetRumble, setPrimAlpha, WaitSema, SignalSema, CreateSema, sceWrite, scePadPortOpen, serve_mtap, fn_8009F748); 1 moot (MovieValidateFrameFormat is inlined at its only call site - there is no `bl` in the caller's stream, so the parameter has no call-site cost); 2 pin-blinded and then settled from the target half (fn_800DBA80 arity 2 confirmed, MovieValidateFrameFormat); 4 deferred to claimed TUs (CritterCollideItems and CritterCollidePlayers in game/enemy/critter and sel_set_choice in game/ui/select, both held by worker NX; hide_rune_stones in game/ui/auxscreen, also NX) and 1 deferred for pin risk (DoLighting in game/world/items, whose sibling AddItemInstList is a filed webfrank rule customer of worker WS this run). NET: 61 rows, 2 defects, 3 hygiene closes, 48 refuted, 3 undecidable-at-zero-cost, 5 deferred. The census was worth running and the class is now closed rather than merely counted.
